01081 Bal'adan {bal-a-da:n'}

源自 01078 和 0113 的縮短型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Baladan 2; 2

巴拉但 = "巴力 (是他的) 主"
1) 米羅達巴拉但的父親, 希西家王曾向米羅達巴拉但的使者展示豐厚財產 (#賽 39:1-4|)
record.edic_text:
01081 Bal'adan {bal-ad-awn'}

from 01078 and 0113 (contracted);; n pr m

AV - Baladan 2; 2

Baladan = "Bel (is his) lord)"
1) the father of Merodach-baladan to whom Hezekiah revealed the riches
   of his treasures
